jobs.title: Director, Engineering-(Onsite) Overland Park, KS
jobs.description:
Build technology that helps move healthcare forward.

Netsmart is seeking a Director, Engineering Development to lead software engineering teams focused on building scalable, reliable, and high-quality technology solutions that support our healthcare platform and the clients we serve.

About Netsmart

Netsmart is a leading healthcare technology organization dedicated to Moving Healthcare Forward, Together. For more than 55 years, Netsmart has partnered with community-based and post-acute care providers to improve outcomes for the individuals and communities they serve.

Role Overview

We are seeking a Director, Engineering Development to lead software engineering teams focused on enterprise software delivery, platform scalability, technical excellence, and strong execution. This is an onsite leadership role based in Overland Park, KS.

This role is ideal for an engineering leader who grew up through software development, technical leadership, or architecture and brings credibility with engineering teams because they understand how modern software is designed, built, shipped, and supported.

The right leader will bring a strong development foundation, the ability to guide architecture and delivery decisions, and experience working with distributed teams, including teams in India. This leader will balance technical depth with people leadership, delivery discipline, and cross-functional partnership.

Key Responsibilities

Engineering Leadership & Delivery

Lead software engineering teams responsible for building, enhancing, and supporting enterprise healthcare technology solutions
Drive execution across software quality, performance, security, reliability, scalability, and operational readiness
Translate product and business priorities into engineering roadmaps, delivery plans, milestones, and measurable outcomes
Create clarity around priorities, ownership, decision-making, dependencies, and delivery expectations
Ensure teams are delivering high-quality software through disciplined Agile practices and structured execution
Partner with leaders across engineering, product, architecture, and operations to remove obstacles and improve delivery flow

Technical & Architecture Leadership

Provide technical leadership across application development, architecture, integrations, APIs, cloud-based systems, and platform modernization
Guide architecture and engineering tradeoffs using practical, hands-on knowledge of software development
Partner with architects and senior engineers to establish reusable patterns, technical standards, design practices, and code quality expectations
Promote scalable, maintainable, and sustainable engineering practices across teams
Help teams modernize platforms, reduce technical debt, and improve system performance and reliability
Bring credibility to technical conversations through a background in engineering, architecture, or hands-on software delivery

Global Team Leadership

Lead and collaborate with distributed engineering teams, including teams based in India
Build strong working relationships across geographies, time zones, and cultures
Create consistent expectations for delivery, communication, accountability, and engineering standards across global teams
Partner effectively with offshore and onsite leaders to ensure alignment, execution, and team engagement
Support a collaborative operating model that enables teams to move efficiently while maintaining quality and clarity

People Leadership & Talent Development

Lead, coach, and develop high-performing engineering teams and engineering leaders
Mentor managers, technical leads, architects, and engineers to strengthen technical capability and leadership effectiveness
Build a culture of accountability, ownership, collaboration, and continuous improvement
Recruit, retain, and grow technical talent aligned with Netsmart values, engineering standards, and delivery expectations
Help teams navigate complexity, prioritize effectively, and stay focused on business and client impact

Cross-Functional Partnership

Partner closely with Product Management to deliver solutions aligned to client needs, market priorities, and business outcomes
Collaborate with Security, Compliance, Operations, Architecture, and business stakeholders to ensure solutions are reliable, secure, and scalable
Communicate technical strategy, delivery progress, risks, and tradeoffs clearly to senior leaders and cross-functional partners
Build trust with stakeholders through transparency, sound judgment, and consistent execution

Qualifications

Required

10+ years of software engineering, software development, or technology leadership experience
Proven experience leading engineering teams with increasing scope and accountability
Strong foundation as a software engineer, technical lead, architect, or engineering leader
Demonstrated ability to guide architecture, software design, engineering execution, and delivery strategy
Strong understanding of modern software development practices, Agile delivery, DevOps, APIs, integrations, cloud-based architectures, and distributed systems
Experience leading global or distributed engineering teams, including teams in India
Ability to operate effectively in a matrixed organization and partner across engineering, product, architecture, security, operations, and business teams
Strong communication, people leadership, technical judgment, execution discipline, and stakeholder management skills
Ability to work onsite in Overland Park, KS

Preferred

Healthcare technology experience
Experience working in regulated industries
Experience modernizing engineering practices, improving platform scalability, or establishing reusable architecture patterns
Experience leading teams through technical transformation, platform modernization, or enterprise software delivery
Background in software architecture, application development, or technical leadership within enterprise product environments

What Success Looks Like

Success in this role means becoming a trusted engineering leader who can turn strategy into practical execution. You will help teams deliver scalable technology solutions, strengthen engineering discipline, and continue building a high-performing engineering culture.

You will be known for strong technical credibility, clear operating discipline, people leadership, and the ability to partner across the organization to deliver technology that supports clients, providers, and communities.

Why Netsmart

At Netsmart, you will build technology that truly matters. This role offers the opportunity to lead impactful engineering development work within a mission-driven organization where innovation supports clinicians, providers, organizations, and communities every day.

This is an opportunity for a proven engineering leader to join Netsmart onsite in Overland Park, KS and help lead the next chapter of software engineering excellence.

Netsmart Values in Action

Value

How This Leader Shows Up

Bold

Makes clear technical decisions, challenges assumptions, and helps teams move complex work forward.

Passionate

Cares deeply about engineering excellence, associate growth, and technology that supports healthcare impact.

Relentless

Drives accountability, delivery discipline, and continuous improvement through complexity.

Collaborative

Builds trust across engineering, product, architecture, operations, and global teams.

Netsmart is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer, providing equal employment and advancement opportunities to all individuals. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all associates. All employment decisions at Netsmart, including but not limited to recruiting, hiring, promotion and transfer, are based on performance, qualifications, abilities, education and experience. Netsmart does not discriminate in employment opportunities or practices based on race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, physical or mental disability, past or present military service, or any other status protected by the laws or regulations in the locations where we operate.

Netsmart desires to provide a healthy and safe workplace and, as a government contractor, Netsmart is committed to maintaining a drug-free workplace in accordance with applicable federal law. Pursuant to Netsmart policy, all post-offer candidates are required to successfully complete a pre-employment background check, including a drug screen, which is provided at Netsmart’s sole expense. In the event a candidate tests positive for a controlled substance, Netsmart will rescind the offer of employment unless the individual can provide proof of valid prescription to Netsmart’s third party screening provider.

jobs.title: Director, Software Engineering: Java
jobs.description:
Duties:

Responsible for directing a diversely skilled team of talented software engineers working on building foundational components required by OCC’s Renaissance Risk Platform, all while enriching and advancing the platform providing sound technical decisions around design, architecture and development. Design and deliver low-latency, fault-tolerant real-time financial data pipeline systems requiring specialized expertise in Apache Kafka and Apache Flink, including advanced performance profiling, memory optimization, and throughput tuning for high-volume enterprise workloads. Solve problems creatively, communicate effectively within and outside the team and proactively engage in technical decision making to achieve desired objectives. Direct the architecture and implementation of enterprise financial risk processing systems requiring deep expertise in Java, Spring Boot, and Apache Flink, including design of high-concurrency, low-latency risk computation engines, real-time event-driven microservices, and complex quantitative risk model integrations to aggregate, process, and model financial risk data from heterogeneous source platforms at enterprise scale. (replaced simpler job duty). Act as technical product owner in flushing out detailed business, architectural & design requirements. Lead development of solution / solution architecture on Renaissance Risk Platform core team. Execute large-scale cloud migration strategies requiring specialized knowledge of AWS infrastructure and CI/CD automation using Jenkins, Harness, and Docker to modernize complex legacy financial systems while sustaining zero-downtime delivery across terabyte-scale data workloads. Drive various enterprise level architecture initiatives covering Risk Platform interactions at enterprise level and help flush out reference architecture with POC/Designs. Implement end-to-end production observability frameworks for distributed financial streaming applications requiring advanced expertise in Splunk and AppDynamics for real-time performance monitoring, anomaly detection, and incident resolution at enterprise scale. Solicit business for their technical requirements and translate those into flexible, scalable, resilient design proposals. Review architecture proposals with tech leads and senior business partners. Lead and direct team to deliver complex IT projects which may involve multiple systems. Analyze, document, refine, and maintain architectures that are developed within the team. Create strategies and transition plans to deliver target state architectures. Recommend technologies and tools that improve the efficiency and quality of OCC’s systems and development processes. Up to 40% telecommuting permitted. *This position qualifies for The Options Clearing Corporation’s Employee Referral Program.*

Education & Experience Required:

Bachelor’s degree in computer science, computer engineering, or related and seven (7) years of experience as an application developer, software engineer, Java developer, or related

Special Skills Required:

Must have work experience with each of the following: 1) Designing and delivering low-latency, fault-tolerant real-time financial data pipeline systems requiring specialized expertise in Apache Kafka and Apache Flink, including advanced performance profiling, memory optimization, and throughput tuning for high-volume enterprise workloads; 2) Directing the architecture and implementation of enterprise financial risk processing systems requiring deep expertise in Java, Spring Boot, and Apache Flink, including design of high-concurrency, low-latency risk computation engines, real-time event-driven microservices, and complex quantitative risk model integrations to aggregate, process, and model financial risk data from heterogeneous source platforms at enterprise scale; 3) Executing large-scale cloud migration strategies requiring specialized knowledge of AWS infrastructure and CI/CD automation using Jenkins, Harness, and Docker to modernize complex legacy financial systems while sustaining zero-downtime delivery across terabyte-scale data workloads; and 4) Implementing end-to-end production observability frameworks for distributed financial streaming applications requiring advanced expertise in Splunk and AppDynamics for real-time performance monitoring, anomaly detection, and incident resolution at enterprise scale. Up to 40% telecommuting permitted.

Salary

$229,800-$286,800

Apply:

Apply online at www.theocc.com. No calls. EOE.

About Us

The Options Clearing Corporation (OCC) is the world's largest equity derivatives clearing organization. Founded in 1973, OCC is dedicated to promoting stability and market integrity by delivering clearing and settlement services for options, futures and securities lending transactions. As a Systemically Important Financial Market Utility (SIFMU), OCC operates under the jurisdiction of the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC), the U.S. Commodity Futures Trading Commission (CFTC), and the Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System. OCC has more than 100 clearing members and provides central counterparty (CCP) clearing and settlement services to 19 exchanges and trading platforms. More information about OCC is available at www.theocc.com.

Benefits

A highly collaborative and supportive environment developed to encourage work-life balance and employee wellness. Some of these components include:

A hybrid work environment, up to 2 days per week of remote work
Tuition Reimbursement to support your continued education
Student Loan Repayment Assistance
Technology Stipend allowing you to use the device of your choice to connect to our network while working remotely
Generous PTO and Parental leave
401k Employer Match
Competitive health benefits including medical, dental and vision

Visit https://www.theocc.com/careers/thriving-together for more information.

Compensation

The salary range listed for any given position is exclusive of fringe benefits and potential bonuses. If hired at OCC, your final base salary compensation will be determined by factors such as skills, experience and/or education.
In addition, we believe in the importance of pay equity and consider internal equity of our current team members as part of any final offer.
We typically do not hire at the maximum of the range in order to allow for future and continued salary growth. We also offer a substantial benefits package as noted on www.theocc.com/careers
All employees may be eligible for a discretionary bonus. Discretionary bonuses are based on various factors, including, but not limited to, company and individual performance and are not guaranteed.

jobs.description:
Axial Search is a specialist executive search firm built for one kind of hire: leaders who help organizations navigate AI transformation. Apply today to express your interest in roles like this one.

Visit our website to learn more about our process and explore free tools for your job search, including our live job market dashboard with salary, skills and hiring trend data from thousands of AI transformation roles.

What The Market Looks Like

We've tracked 500+ senior-level postings in AI architecture across the US over the last six months, with strong demand in California, Texas, and New York—particularly in technology, financial services, and professional services. Compensation typically ranges from $250K to $430K annually. The strongest candidates bring hands-on experience architecting AI systems at scale, deep fluency in modern ML infrastructure and deployment patterns, and the ability to translate technical complexity into business value. These leaders often combine deep engineering judgment with the communication skills needed to partner across product, data, and operations teams.

Job Responsibilities

Own the technical strategy and roadmap for AI platform capabilities, balancing innovation with reliability and operational cost.
Design and evolve the architecture for model development, training, inference, and monitoring infrastructure to support multiple use cases across the organization.
Lead a team of AI/ML engineers, architects, and platform specialists—setting technical standards, conducting architecture reviews, and mentoring for growth.
Partner with product and business leaders to translate AI opportunities into technical requirements and feasible delivery plans.
Drive decisions on build vs. buy, open-source vs. proprietary, and cloud infrastructure choices—evaluating trade-offs in performance, cost, and time-to-market.
Establish observability, governance, and security practices for AI systems, including model versioning, explainability, bias detection, and compliance frameworks.
Collaborate with data engineering and data science teams to integrate feature pipelines, data quality checks, and retraining workflows into platform operations.

Candidate Requirements

10+ years of software engineering or ML systems experience, with at least 4–5 years in AI architecture, platform engineering, or leading ML infrastructure teams.
Demonstrable track record architecting and shipping production AI systems (large language models, computer vision, forecasting, recommender systems, or similar) at meaningful scale.
Deep hands-on knowledge of model serving frameworks, training infrastructure, vector databases, experiment tracking, and monitoring tools in modern ML stacks.
Proven ability to lead and grow engineering teams, set technical vision, and communicate trade-offs to non-technical stakeholders.
Strong judgment on system design—experience with distributed systems, data pipelines, or cloud infrastructure decisions and their business implications.
Familiarity with governance, security, and compliance considerations in AI systems (model governance, bias mitigation, regulatory frameworks).

jobs.title: Director of Engineering, Solution Engineering and Support
jobs.description:
Who We Are

Claritas Rx uses AI and predictive modeling to help rare disease and specialty brands remove the barriers that keep patients from accessing and staying on the treatments they need. By uniting the most complete view of the patient journey with purpose-built technologies, we predict and resolve access challenges before they disrupt care, combining advanced analytics, real-world data, AI, and CRM capabilities to increase start and refill rates, reduce abandonment, and improve brand performance. Our mission is to ensure patients with chronic, life-threatening diseases receive the support that enables the greatest benefit from their therapy. Simply put, our promise is progress for every patient journey.

This is the opportunity to help shape a first-in-industry digital health solution alongside a team of mission-driven professionals. We were named one of Inc.'s Best Workplaces in 2025 and recognized on the Inc. 5000 list for two consecutive years (2025 and 2026), and our team genuinely respects and supports each other. We thrive on being fast-paced, innovative, and results-driven, and our employees enjoy a flexible, collaborative work environment, unlimited PTO, stock options, and a growing set of tools and technology to drive innovation for our customers.

The Position

We are a rapidly growing healthcare technology company seeking a Director of Engineering to lead Solution Engineering and Customer Support Operations within our Customer Engineering organization. Reporting directly to the Head of Customer Engineering, you will own our technical engagement with customers before and after implementation: shaping the right solution during the sales cycle, and ensuring stable, high-quality support once customers are live on the Ascend platform. You will partner closely with the Director of Implementations, Product, Sales, Customer Success, and Platform Engineering, and you will build and lead a blended team of onshore employees and offshore contractor partners. Our platform ingests, validates, masters, and analyzes complex specialty pharmacy, hub, and payer data, turning it into actionable insights for biopharmaceutical manufacturers. This role is primarily remote with occasional travel requirements of up to 25%.

Key Accountabilities

Leadership And Operations

Build, lead, and develop a team of solution engineers, data engineers, and support engineers across onshore FTEs and offshore contractor partners, including hiring, onboarding, performance management, and career development.
Define team charters, operating models, and clear handoffs with Implementations (pre-sales to kickoff, and go-live to support) so customers experience one continuous Customer Engineering team.
Establish and report on metrics for both functions, such as SLA attainment, ticket volume and aging, incident trends, estimate accuracy, and solution win rates.
Own capacity planning, contractor vendor relationships, and budget for the teams in scope.

Solution Engineering

Serve as the technical lead in pre-sales: lead discovery, solution design, technical demos, and responses to RFPs, RFIs, and security questionnaires.
Translate customer business requirements into solution designs that fit the standard Ascend offering, and identify where paid add-on services or custom extracts are needed.
Review SOWs and level-of-effort estimates for technical accuracy, scope, and delivery risk before they are signed.
Own the system architecture view for each customer engagement, covering data sources, ingestion, integrations, and outbound extracts.
Disposition product gaps surfaced during the sales cycle, routing them to Product with clear business context and customer impact.
Ensure a clean technical handoff to Implementations at kickoff, including documented scope, assumptions, and data source inventory.

Customer Support Operations

Own post-go-live technical support for customers on the Ascend platform, including production support, issue triage, root cause analysis, and resolution.
Lead KTLO and sustainment for existing Ascend customers, and drive ongoing optimization to reduce cost and effort.
Build and scale the Ascend support model as new and existing customers go live, including runbooks, coverage, escalation paths, and SLAs.
Partner with Infrastructure and Platform Engineering on environment health, monitoring, data pipeline reliability, and access management.
Manage intake, prioritization, and delivery of customer enhancement requests and ongoing reporting needs.
Identify recurring issues and partner with Product and Engineering on permanent fixes that reduce support load.
Act as the escalation point for critical incidents and data quality issues, communicating clearly with customer and internal stakeholders.

Who You Are

Skills/Knowledge

Proven people leader who has built and scaled teams, including distributed teams with offshore contractor partners.
Strong hands-on background in data engineering and data platforms: ETL/ELT pipelines, SQL, data modeling, and data quality.
Experience with AWS data and infrastructure services (such as S3, Glue, Lambda, and Redshift or Snowflake) and orchestration tools such as Airflow.
Able to explain complex technical concepts to business stakeholders and executives, and to represent Claritas Rx credibly in front of customers.
Experience defining SLAs, support processes, and ticketing workflows (such as Jira Service Management), and using metrics to run the function.
Entrepreneurial and resourceful: we need people who can find creative ways to make a big impact quickly and without much direction.

Requirements

BS degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Math, or another STEM related field
12+ years of experience in software or data engineering, including 5+ years leading engineering teams
Experience leading both a customer-facing technical team (solution engineering, sales engineering, or professional services) and a technical support or production operations team

Preferred Skills

SaaS experience in a similar customer-facing role, such as solutions engineering or professional services, ideally at a growth stage or start-up company. Or a consulting background in client-facing technical delivery, such as technology, data, or life sciences consulting.
Understanding of the life sciences commercial data ecosystem, including specialty pharmacy, hub, distributor, and payer data.
Experience supporting customers through a platform migration or major version upgrade.
Experience working with PHI in a HIPAA-regulated data environment.

Join Us

We are seeking to add new expertise and perspective to our strong team of experienced professionals. We aspire to a culture of accelerated professional development through: shared learning and collaboration; a respectful and fun work environment; and employee empowerment through the effective use of technology and tools.

We are a highly collaborative team and prioritize opportunities to connect in person. For employees within a reasonable driving distance of each other, we host regional town hall gatherings approximately every other month. These sessions give our teams a chance to come together, share updates, and strengthen relationships beyond day-to-day work.

In addition to our great environment, we offer a competitive salary of $195,000 to $220,000
and benefits package and the opportunity to make a significant impact on a first-in-industry digital health solution. Please send a cover letter along with your resume when applying to the position of interest. Claritas Rx embraces diversity, equality, and transparency. We are committed to building a team that comprises a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and talents. We believe the more inclusive we are, the better we are.

Join us and discover what it feels like to be part of an environment that rewards ingenuity, risk taking and smart work. It's time to fall in love with what you do!

At Claritas Rx, protecting our candidates is a top priority. If you're applying for a role with us, please note:

All legitimate opportunities are posted first on ClaritasRx.com. Check there before trusting external listings.
We believe in meaningful interviews: offers never come after just one phone call or form. Expect multiple video calls to get to know you.
We never ask for fees or payments of any kind during the hiring process.
Our People Operations Team will handle your onboarding, and all equipment comes directly from us—no purchases required.

jobs.title: Data Engineering Vice President, Data Engineering – BlackRock Data Office
jobs.description:
About This Role

What team will you be on?

The BlackRock Data Office (BDO) advances the firm's enterprise data strategy by building trusted, scalable, and governed data products that power investment, business, operational, and technology outcomes across BlackRock. As a member of the Data Office organization, you will partner closely with product managers, data stewards, platform engineers, software engineers, data scientists, and senior business stakeholders to deliver enterprise data capabilities that enable analytics, reporting, artificial intelligence, machine learning, and digital products. The team is at the forefront of shaping BlackRock's next generation data ecosystem and driving data as a strategic asset across the firm.

Why is your role important?

As a Vice President, Data Engineering, you will provide technical leadership for enterprise-scale data platforms, influence architectural direction, and drive the delivery of high-impact data solutions that support critical business and investment outcomes. You will lead complex engineering initiatives, establish best practices across teams, and serve as a trusted partner to stakeholders across technology and the business. This role offers the opportunity to shape long-term data strategy, mentor engineering talent, and accelerate the firm's adoption of modern data and AI-enabled capabilities.

What will you be doing?

In every role at BlackRock, you'll be expected to apply sound judgement and critical thinking to solve complex problems, adapt as the business evolves, and combine the curiosity to explore new approaches and technologies with the rigor to challenge the results. The scope of this role also includes the following responsibilities.

Lead the architecture, design, and delivery of scalable, resilient, and high-performance data products and pipelines supporting enterprise-wide business, analytics, and investment capabilities.
Drive technical strategy for batch and real-time data ingestion, transformation, and distribution platforms, ensuring alignment with enterprise architecture, governance, security, and data-quality standards.
Establish and advance engineering best practices, reusable frameworks, automation capabilities, CI/CD processes, observability standards, and operational excellence across the data engineering organization.
Partner with senior stakeholders, product leaders, and engineering teams to prioritize strategic initiatives, influence roadmaps, and deliver business outcomes through trusted and accessible data products.
Champion platform scalability, reliability, resiliency, and cost optimization through architectural improvements, performance tuning, and proactive operational management.
Lead complex incident resolution, root-cause analysis, and continuous-improvement efforts while fostering a culture of accountability, innovation, and engineering excellence.
Mentor and develop engineering talent, provide technical leadership across teams, and help define the future direction of BlackRock's enterprise data ecosystem and AI-ready platform capabilities.

What are we looking for?

Demonstrated ability to lead complex data-engineering initiatives, influence technical strategy, and collaborate across global, cross-functional teams consisting of engineering, product, governance, and business stakeholders.
Deep expertise in Python, Java, Scala, SQL, Snowflake, cloud-based data platforms, and large-scale distributed data analytics environments, with a proven track record of delivering enterprise-grade solutions.
Strong experience designing and operating high-volume batch and real-time data pipelines, workflow orchestration solutions, data-transformation frameworks, and distributed event streaming architectures.
Expertise in cloud and hybrid technology environments, including AWS, Microsoft Azure, containerized platforms, infrastructure automation, data governance, metadata management, lineage, and enterprise security controls.
Strong understanding of application programming interfaces, data modeling, data-quality frameworks, observability, performance optimization, and modern software-engineering practices supporting scalable platforms.
Experience leading technical teams, mentoring engineers, driving architectural decisions, and influencing organizational standards in a fast-paced, highly collaborative environment.
Exposure to machine learning, artificial intelligence, generative AI, and enterprise data patterns that enable AI-ready products and platforms.

For NY7 - 50 Hudson Yards, New York Only the salary range for this position is USD$0.00 - USD$0.00 . Additionally, employees are eligible for an annual discretionary bonus, and benefits including healthcare, leave benefits, and retirement benefits. BlackRock operates a pay-for-performance compensation philosophy and your total compensation may vary based on role, location, and firm, department and individual performance.

Our Benefits

To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of benefits including a strong retirement plan, tuition reimbursement, comprehensive healthcare, support for working parents and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about.

Our hybrid work model

BlackRock’s hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. Some business groups may require more time in the office due to their roles and responsibilities. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person – aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. As a new joiner, you can count on this hybrid model to accelerate your learning and onboarding experience here at BlackRock.

Guidance on AI use for candidates

At BlackRock, AI has long been part of how we work – enhancing decision-making, improving operations, and helping us deliver better outcomes for clients. We encourage candidates to use AI thoughtfully to learn, prepare, and work more effectively; but during our interview process, we want to focus on getting to know you through your own experiences, thinking, and judgment. To support you, we’ve provided guidance
on when and how to use AI during our hiring process so you can approach each step with confidence and showcase your best self.

About BlackRock

At BlackRock, we are all connected by one mission: to help more and more people experience financial well-being. Our clients, and the people they serve, are saving for retirement, paying for their children’s educations, buying homes and starting businesses. Their investments also help to strengthen the global economy: support businesses small and large; finance infrastructure projects that connect and power cities; and facilitate innovations that drive progress.

This mission would not be possible without our smartest investment – the one we make in our employees. It’s why we’re dedicated to creating an environment where our colleagues feel welcomed, valued and supported with networks, benefits and development opportunities to help them thrive.

To learn more about BlackRock, please visit Careers.BlackRock.com. We also encourage you to get to know us on LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, X, and TikTok.

jobs.title: Security Engineering - New York - Vice President
jobs.description:
Job Description

WHO WE ARE

Led by the Chief Information Security Officer (CISO), Technology Risk secures Goldman Sachs against hackers and other cyber threats. We are responsible for detecting and preventing attempted cyber intrusions against the firm, helping the firm develop more secure applications and infrastructure, developing software in support of our efforts, measuring cybersecurity risk, and designing and driving implementation of cybersecurity controls. The team has global presence across the Americas, APAC, India and EMEA.

Within Technology Risk, Advisory is the consultative and technology subject matter expertise arm, responsible for assessing new technology initiatives for risk, partnering with engineers to architect and design secure products and services, embedding implementation reviews as part of the SDLC and CI/CD pipeline via code analysis and penetration testing, and guiding technology innovation in terms of security and control across Goldman Sachs. The team plays a critical role in designing and assessing controls for our transition to building native public cloud applications.

Goldman Sachs has one of the most progressive Technology Risk teams in the industry and is continuing to push the development of risk in preference to security within technology and the business. Year on year success has led the team to work deeper into the organization and gain valuable insights into how technology needs to function, what its risk really is and how this impacts the business.

Role

In this role, you will support Technology Risk Advisory in delivering best in class advisory support and technology solutions across the Information Security risk domains, including scalable uplifts of common core security solutions for use across Goldman Sachs, conducting cyber risk assessments and driving risk reduction across the portfolio

The ideal candidate should have a good understanding of regulations that govern this space, be well versed in risk assessments and a demonstrated ability in helping counterparts manage risk

Responsibilities And Qualifications

Job Responsibilities:
Support the Technology Risk Advisory function by helping to shape the Vendor Technology Risk strategy, leading a team that assesses threats, risks, and working with Business Units to manage risk portfolios.

As the Vendor Risk Program Vice President, you will be part of or oversee a team that is responsible for assessing and managing the portfolio vendor Information Security Risk across the firm. Your team will be responsible for all Vendor Technology Risk related initiatives and assessments, including core deep-dive technical cybersecurity assessments and designs of a vendor’s logical security controls, Cloud security assessments, Mobile security assessments, and/or Application security assessments.

Basic Qualifications

Be well versed in technical cybersecurity risk assessments, provide security measures / solution technical controls, and a demonstrated ability in helping counterparts manage security risks
Develop, evaluate, solution, and document security measures, controls, and guardrails to protect data, applications, APIs, implementation / configurations, network infrastructure and systems (e.g., Security Engineer, Architect, Vulnerability Manager).

jobs.title: Head of Restaurant Technology
jobs.description:
The Head of Restaurant Technology is responsible for the end-to-end ownership of all technology systems, connected devices, and digital infrastructure across Concessions International's restaurant footprint. Reporting directly to the CITO, this leader will define and execute a forward-looking restaurant technology strategy that elevates guest experience, enables operational efficiency, and supports the company's growth across airports and hospitality venues.

This role is fundamentally about guest experience whereby using technology as a lever to make every dining moment faster, smarter, and more memorable. Whether a traveler has 10 minutes before boarding or an hour to spare, this leader will ensure the technology powering that experience is seamless, reliable, and always improving. The ideal candidate should be equally comfortable rolling up their sleeves to troubleshoot a POS outage or triaging degraded network connectivity at a unit.

Technology Strategy & Innovation

Define and own the multi-year restaurant technology roadmap aligned to CI's operational and revenue growth goals
Champion a culture of innovation, continuously scanning the food & beverage, hospitality and retail tech landscape for ideas that meaningfully improve the dining experience
Serve as technology advisor to operations leadership for all restaurant and concessions locations
Identify and pilot emerging technologies such as AI-driven ordering, personalization engines, IoT kitchen monitoring, predictive inventory, and contactless payment that deliver competitive advantage in the airport dining environment
Translate guest experience goals into technology requirements: faster ordering, reduced wait times, smarter upsell, and frictionless payment
Build an innovation pipeline with clear evaluation criteria: guest impact, operational feasibility, and ROI

Guest Experience & Dining Innovation

Own the guest-facing technology experience across all CI locations from digital menu boards and self-service kiosks to mobile ordering and integrations
Use guest feedback, transaction data, and operational analytics to continuously improve the technology experience and identify friction points
Drive adoption of technology that increases average check, improves throughput, and creates memorable dining moments
Lead planning, deployment, and rollout of all restaurant-facing technology systems, POS, KDS, digital menu boards, self-service kiosks, payment processing, and other platforms
Own the full lifecycle of connected devices across all locations from procurement and provisioning to decommission
Establish repeatable implementation playbooks and standards for new location openings and remodels
Ensure all deployments meet security, compliance, and network standards in coordination with the broader IT team
Drive integration between restaurant systems and enterprise platforms (ERP, workforce management, finance)

Operations & Support

Own the technology support model for all restaurant locations in partnership with MSP’s and IT Operations team
Build and lead a high-performing restaurant technology team including engineers, support analysts, and project coordinators
Establish monitoring and alerting practices to proactively detect and resolve system issues before they impact operations
Partner with operations leadership to define technology-related KPIs (uptime, transaction speed, device availability)
Drive a continuous improvement culture regularly soliciting feedback from operations leaders and translating it into system improvements

Vendor & Partner Management

Own all vendor relationships for restaurant technology, POS providers, hardware OEMs, payment processors, and integration partners
Lead contract negotiations, renewal cycles, and SLA governance for all restaurant technology vendors
Manage vendor performance scorecards and escalate underperformance proactively
Evaluate and onboard new technology partners that align with CI's operational direction

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or related field. Master’s degree preferred.
10+ years of progressive technology leadership experience, with at least 3 years in restaurant, food & beverage, hospitality, or retail technology
Demonstrated ownership of POS platforms at scale (Oracle MICROS, Toast, NCR Aloha, PAX, or equivalent)
Experience managing technology across 20+ locations in a multi-site or franchise environment
Proven track record of end-to-end technology delivery: strategy through implementation through support
Strong vendor management experience including contract negotiation and SLA governance
Experience leading cross-functional teams and building technology organization

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in airport, travel retail, or high-throughput food service environments
Familiarity with concessions, quick service restaurant (QSR), or fast casual technology models
Exposure to AI-powered ordering, predictive inventory, or self-service kiosk deployments

Technical Competencies

POS & Kitchen Systems: POS platforms, KDS, order management, digital menu boards
Payments & Compliance: EMV, NFC/contactless, PCI-DSS, payment gateway integrations
Connected Devices & IoT: Network-connected device management, MDM/RMM platforms, IoT sensors
Networking: Retail/hospitality-grade LAN/WAN, wireless infrastructure, SD-WAN
Integrations: API-based integration between restaurant and enterprise systems (ERP, labor, loyalty)
Data & Analytics: Operational dashboards, transaction analytics, reporting infrastructure
